notes:
Lead: BulkShift (large CX outsourcing + SaaS platform). They operate 24/7 multiregional chat ops; heavy peak spikes (weekly marketing blasts) produce 800-1,200 concurrent customer chats across channels. Primary goal: reduce live agent handoffs via automated deflection + agent assist for complex flows.

Key quotes: "We need predictable unit economics — if the math doesn't work, ops will reject." — Director of Product.

Acceptance criteria for POC: p95 latency for generation <= 300ms avg for single-turn agent assist flows; sustain 1k concurrent chat sessions with fallbacks; overall per-conversation inference cost target < $0.01 (goal $0.005) to justify roll-out.

Technical constraints: must support signed webhook tool-calls to internal ticketing system, SAML SSO for admin console, and audit logs retained 7+ years for a subset of customers. Prefer VPC/private endpoints for production but ok to pilot on hosted with encryption-in-transit.

Risk notes: high sensitivity to quality regressions after aggressive quantization. They will run evals on a 2k-case prompt set (can provide) and expect Redwood Optimize suggestions for quant profiles.

Commercial: leaning toward Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable cost but want to bake Optimize recommendations to lower commit. Procurement is on the Q4 budget cycle.
